title: Concept: Stripe live secret key served in a response
description: A live secret key is complete authority over the payment account. Once it appears in a page it is in caches, in logs and in any screenshot of that page, so the only safe interpretation is that it has leaked and must be rotated.
applicability: Responses that render configuration, a client-side bundle built with server variables, or an error that prints environment values.
risk: The caller can create charges, issue refunds or read customer payment data against the live account.
